definition: An order placed within 30 days of a buyer clicking an Etsy Offsite Ad. Offsite Ads fees are charged only on these orders.
Capable of being easily seen with normal handling of the article or its container.
The country of manufacture, production, or growth of an article of foreign origin. Work done in another country changes the origin only if it is a substantial transformation.

A refund, in whole or in part, of duties, taxes and/or fees paid on imported merchandise. For unused-merchandise drawback, the goods must be exported or destroyed, without use in the United States, within 5 years of importation. It is not allowed on antidumping and countervailing duties.
CBP's general informal entry type for merchandise valued at $2,500 or less.
An importer of record that does not meet CBP's criteria for a U.S. importer of record, under the interim final rule effective January 5, 2027.
Merchandise not entered within the time provided by law. It is moved to the public stores or a general order warehouse at the consignee's risk and expense.
The 4-digit level of a Harmonized Tariff Schedule code. Tariff rates are assigned at the 8-digit level.

The person primarily liable for paying any duties on the merchandise. That may be the consignee, the importer of record, or the actual owner if an actual owner's declaration and superseding bond are filed.
An ad valorem CBP fee of 0.3464% on formally entered or released merchandise, payable by the importer of record, subject to a minimum and maximum per entry ($34.58 and $670.86 for fiscal year 2027).
A foreign-trade zone status under which the goods are classified at the rate in force on the date the application for that status is filed. Once granted, it cannot be abandoned.
A foreign-trade zone site, or group of sites, established for a specific use.
The price actually paid or payable for merchandise when sold for exportation to the United States, plus specified additions. It is the first valuation method CBP applies.
Generally the last person in the United States who will receive the article in the form in which it was imported. For goods sold at retail in imported form, that is the retail buyer.
A foreign-trade zone status for goods taken into a zone only for exportation, destruction or storage. It cannot be abandoned once granted.
